## TakeAmountsLib.prices() function

Computes buyer and seller prices for an offer and settlement fee.

**Signature:**

```typescript
function prices(params: {
        readonly offer: {
            readonly buy: boolean;
            readonly tick: BigIntish;
        };
        readonly settlementFee: BigIntish;
    }): {
        readonly buyerPrice: bigint;
        readonly sellerPrice: bigint;
    };
```

**Returns:**

{ readonly buyerPrice: bigint; readonly sellerPrice: bigint; }

Buyer and seller prices.

## Exceptions

`NegativeValueError` when `settlementFee` or the offer tick is negative.

`TickOutOfRangeError` when the offer tick exceeds `MAX_TICK`<!-- -->.

`SettlementFeeExceedsPriceError` when settlement fee exceeds a buy offer price.

## Remarks

Parameter details:

- `params.offer.buy`<!-- -->: Whether the maker buys loan assets.

- `params.offer.tick`<!-- -->: Offer tick used to compute the base price.

- `params.settlementFee`<!-- -->: WAD-scaled settlement fee for the market and time to maturity.

## Example


```ts
import { TakeAmountsLib } from "@morpho-org/midnight-sdk";

const offer = {
  buy: true,
  tick: 5_820n,
};

const prices = TakeAmountsLib.prices({ offer, settlementFee: 1_000000000000n });
console.log(prices.buyerPrice);
```
